items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: So, they're great, Ted. So, uh... I went along when the time come.

ctx.x: We go down to the telephone exchange. And he was right there. Yeah, Holtz.

Get him to take me. And I agreed, I said, well, I'll answer a little bit. I said, if you're free to take trumpet players, it's a dance game. Well, they had a rope in the back. So, I don't know. I've seen that white thing before. And I didn't see it. So, they're great, Ted. So, uh... I went along when the time come. I had the band all made up. They had Bob Sharper. Was the leader of the band. I taught this out in Ed Allen up there. So, they had a... They had a lady I was playing the piano with. Until I... Go with…
You've been working, you say, at the Cotton Building, was that? Or something like that? They had a way in town. At a day job. Yeah.
